changelog: v0.5.0: 1) Agentic Conversational Memory Framework with multi-turn sliding window dialogue tracking; 2) Fixed prompt-response disconnect on SmolLM2 by eliminating destructive repetition penalty (1.0) and expanding max token limit; 3) Persona alignment and spatial grounding for all avatars; 4) Output validation, ChatML token stripping, and sentence healing before speech synthesis; 5) Detailed diagnostic logging of raw LLM outputs, intent classification, and conversation memory.
